page: Microsoft Azure F32ads_v7 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the Fadsv7 server family, powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9V45 processor. This x86_64 architecture server features 32 physical cores and 32 vCPUs, operating at a clock speed of 4.5 GHz with one thread per core. The hardware configuration includes 128.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the instance is equipped with 3780 GB of local disk capacity and is Premium Storage capable. The virtualization layer is managed by Microsoft Hyper-V.

Benchmark results indicate strong performance characteristics across multiple domains. In single-core processing, the stress-ng CPU test places this instance in the top 10% tier with a score of 3541.18, while multi-core performance ranks in the top 25% tier. Cryptographic and compression capabilities are also notable, with gzip compression and bzip3 decompression single-threaded speeds reaching the top 10% tier. Memory bandwidth is robust, measuring 214.06 GB/sec for large block read-only operations and 125.71 GB/sec for large block write operations, both falling into the top 25% tier.

The inclusion of 3780 GB of local storage alongside top-tier database operation benchmarks, ranking in the top 10% with 37385.95 operations, makes this instance suitable for database workloads and data-intensive tasks. Additionally, the processor's vector extensions support efficient execution of medium-sized language model inference, where text generation for a 7B model reaches top-tier speeds of 42.41 tokens/sec. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and high resource density of memory and local storage provide a balanced profile for enterprise applications, web serving, and relational database management systems without the overhead of a GPU.
description: Microsoft Azure F32ads_v7 is an x86_64 virtual machine from the Fadsv7 family, featuring 32 dedicated AMD EPYC 9V45 cores running at 4.5 GHz. It is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM and 3780 GB of local storage. Operating under Microsoft Hyper-V, this instance delivers top-tier single-core CPU performance and database operations, alongside strong multi-core and memory bandwidth capabilities. The processor supports advanced vector extensions, enabling efficient execution of medium-sized language model inference and cryptographic operations. With its balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio and substantial local storage, the F32ads_v7 is designed for database management, web serving, and general-purpose enterprise workloads requiring dedicated compute resources and high-speed local disk access.
